verdict.rationale: The only self-serve path in the evidence is scripting the paginated GET /fetch/search subscriber endpoint. It can filter by tags, segments and unsubscribe dates, which implies unsubscribed contacts could be pulled via the API, but no dedicated export feature or open-format download is documented. The CLI docs mention importing from CSV, not exporting. Missing for 10: a documented one-click or CLI export to CSV/JSON, confirmation that custom fields and tags are included in exported records, export of engagement/event history, an explicit suppression-list export, and independent corroboration of a working full-audience export.
